package reconnect

import (
	"testing"
	"time"
)

// Scoring-only checks, copied in after the backend finishes so a fix cannot
// special-case the visible test.

func TestReconnectAfterRepeatedDrops(t *testing.T) {
	s := startServer(t)
	client, err := Dial(s.addr())
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	defer client.Close()
	for i := 0; i < 3; i++ {
		if err := client.Send("ping"); err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("send %d: %v", i, err)
		}
		s.dropConnections()
	}
	if err := client.Send("ping"); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("send after repeated drops: %v", err)
	}
}

func TestSendGivesUpWhenServerIsGone(t *testing.T) {
	s := startServer(t)
	client, err := Dial(s.addr())
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	defer client.Close()
	// A reply proves the server registered this connection, so dropping
	// connections below cannot miss it.
	if err := client.Send("ping"); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	s.listener.Close()
	s.dropConnections()
	start := time.Now()
	if err := client.Send("ping"); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("send succeeded with no server")
	}
	if elapsed := time.Since(start); elapsed > ReconnectTimeout+2*time.Second {
		t.Fatalf("send kept retrying for %s; ReconnectTimeout is %s", elapsed, ReconnectTimeout)
	}
}
